analysis.reason: The test expected a 200 response with product details for GET /products/1, but the API returned 404 with body '{"message":"Requested item not found"}'. This indicates the API did not return the requested product as the test expects. From the execution results there is no evidence that the test expectation or contract is incorrect, nor any explicit environment/authentication error—so the behavior appears incorrect or product data is missing on the application side.
analysis.recommendedAction: 1) Reproduce the request manually (GET /products/1) to confirm 404. 2) Verify test data: confirm product with ID 1 exists in the environment and was not removed. 3) Check application logs and data layer for reasons the item was not found. 4) If data exists, debug endpoint implementation to find why it returns 404. 5) If data is missing intentionally, update test data setup or adjust test expectations/contract accordingly.
